sections.heading: Budget Narrative
sections.purpose: Justify the proposed budget, document costs and match, and explain indirect and acquisition costs, including any request for pre-award costs.

required_elements.text: Describe and justify items and costs listed in the budget.
required_elements.excerpt: Applicants must describe and justify items and costs listed in their budget.

required_elements.text: Identify total estimated costs, non-Federal cost share, third-party contributions, and any pre-award costs.
required_elements.excerpt: The budget narrative must identify the following cost items: total estimated costs, non-Federal cost share, third-party contributions, and any pre-award costs.

required_elements.text: Ensure budget items are reasonable, allowable, allocable, necessary, and compliant with 2 CFR 200 Subpart E cost principles.
required_elements.excerpt: Budget items must be: Reasonable, allowable, allocable, and necessary.

required_elements.text: Indicate how indirect costs will be charged, including the rate to be applied.
